### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, `@objectstack/service-push`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **80** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **10** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/index.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/user-device.object.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**19** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 72d7db037b3b78ec4b768df4d266eb6dff288876`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **10** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/index.ts`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/user-device.object.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **27** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **169** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 72d7db037b3b78ec4b768df4d266eb6dff288876` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9645826cc9b325d16c72d594642e4f22beeface4` — the merge of head `5b7095572f3f1836f18a0ef62bd072485353edcd` into base `72d7db037b3b78ec4b768df4d266eb6dff288876`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9645826cc9b325d16c72d594642e4f22beeface4 && git checkout 9645826cc9b325d16c72d594642e4f22beeface4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 72d7db037b3b78ec4b768df4d266eb6dff288876 5b7095572f3f1836f18a0ef62bd072485353edcd && git checkout -B drift-repro 72d7db037b3b78ec4b768df4d266eb6dff288876 && git merge --no-ff 5b7095572f3f1836f18a0ef62bd072485353edcd

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 72d7db037b3b78ec4b768df4d266eb6dff288876
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 72d7db037b3b78ec4b768df4d266eb6dff288876` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Scope: packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/push-delivery.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/notification-service.ts, packages/spec/src/system/notification.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts, docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md + packages/services/service-push/src/push-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-push/src/push-service.ts, packages/services/service-push/src/credential.ts, packages/services/service-push/src/transports/apns.ts, packages/services/service-push/src/transports/fcm.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/push-channel.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/device-registry.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/backoff.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/dispatcher.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/user-device.object.ts, packages/spec/src/system/push-server-origin.ts, packages/spec/src/api/push-delivery.test.ts, packages/spec/src/system/push-config.test.ts, packages/spec/src/system/push-server-origin.test.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/push-channel.test.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-push-delivery.integration.test.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts, docs/adr/0030-notification-platform-convergence.md, docs/adr/0143-outbound-connector-auth-is-open-tier.md (D3), .changeset/29041-push-notification-channel.md, packages/spec/llms.txt. The rest of the diff is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Inputs read: card #29041 body and all 8 comments (triage 6570782253, seat split 6571021055, unblock 6586279808, the package-name question 6592963202 that claim 6594049406 records as ruling A, carried items 6593642547, dev reports 6595865935 and 6596612653); PR #29794 body, file list, net diff `origin/main...pr29794` (merge-base `b3d141505`); check-runs on the head.

Gate verdicts on the head at record time: 26 success, 7 skipped by design, 0 failed. Still pending then: Build Core, Test Core 1–8, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Build & E2E UI, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI 1–16. This PASS stands only if those complete green.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `[PLANNED — not yet read]` comes off `PushServiceConfigSchema`, `ApnsTransportConfigSchema` and `FcmTransportConfigSchema`. Right: `PushServicePlugin.init` parses its config with `PushServiceConfigSchema` and builds one transport per block.
2. `[PLANNED — not yet served]` comes off `PushDeliveryDataSchema`. Right: `push-channel.ts` builds the data and hands it to the push service, and the acceptance test sees `notificationId` and `route` arrive at mock APNs and mock FCM.
3. The three marker pins are flipped. The two device-side pins (`RegisterDeviceRequestSchema.origin`, `UserDeviceSchema.origin` stay `[PLANNED — not yet stored]`) are untouched. Right: `device-registry.ts` neither writes nor reads an origin column.
4. `notification.zod.ts`: `push` is now among the channels service-messaging registers, mounted while its transport service is registered. Right: it mounts through `lazyChannelMount`, as sms and email do. "Fan-out refuses any message addressed to an unregistered channel" is right on the tree (#18050). "push — no template" is right: `TEMPLATE_CHANNELS` is email and sms.
5. `notification-service.ts`: the `invalidateDeviceToken` docblock is now present tense. Right: the channel calls `listDevices` and `invalidateDeviceToken`, delegating to `DeviceRegistry`. Carried item 2 closed.
6. `error-code-ledger.zod.ts`: the `NOT_FOUND` waiver names service-messaging's provenance row. Comment only; the row exists (#29068). Carried item 1 closed.
7. `push-device.zod.ts` and `user-device.object.ts` both say service-messaging owns `sys_user_device`, its push channel reads and retires rows in it, and service-push never touches it. Carried item 3 closed.
8. Public surface: a new package `@objectstack/service-push`. `@objectstack/service-messaging` adds `createPushChannel`, `PushChannelOptions`, `PushSenderSurface` and `PushDeviceSurface`. `@objectstack/spec` changes description and comment text only: no key, shape or export. The accept set widens: a `notify` node or `emit()` naming `push` now delivers where a host composes `PushServicePlugin`. With no push service, `push` is refused exactly as before.

### ② Semver level

The changeset is `patch` for `service-push`, `service-messaging` and `spec`, with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` in the changeset and the PR body. `none` is right: no authorable key, value or metadata type is added, and the `push` enum value already existed. Under "`none` takes `patch`", the minor→patch regrade is the rule. `service-automation` gains only a devDependency and a test. `.changeset/config.json` adds `service-push` to the fixed group. Check Changeset: success. The level holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

- llms.txt package count 73 → 74: accepted. `check:llms-txt` re-derives it, and the tree holds 74.
- Minor → patch regrade: accepted, see ②.
- The push-channel origin copy (`04c9e75da`): accepted. With the marker off, a channel that did not copy the origin would make #29767's description false. `withOrigin` copies only a value the schema admits. See ④ 3.
- Out-of-scope 1: `UserDeviceSchema.locale` says pushes render in the device locale, but the tree renders per recipient (`sys_user.locale`). Escalated: the seat files a service-messaging follow-up card.
- Out-of-scope 2: no served door for push (no capability token, no `config.push` stack key). Confirmed. Escalated: the seat files a `domain:spec` card. The `push-config.zod.ts` docblock states the limit honestly.
- Out-of-scope 3: no per-topic push template. Confirmed; it is a note on the follow-up for item 1.
- Round-2 note: the device-side origin producers are #29767's named follow-up; nothing to file.
- No runtime-services chapter page for `services.push`: it joins the served-door spec card.
- Open questions: none. Security findings: none. No secret or whole token appears in an error or log line; credential errors name the reference only.

### ④ Design judgment

1. `push-config.zod.ts` against ADR-0143 D3, ruling A and its first consumer. Holds. Every docblock sentence now describes served code:
   - the plugin parses at init;
   - the transport resolves the `credentialRef` when it first signs;
   - the open tier resolves an environment variable;
   - an inline secret is refused at init;
   - the package is `@objectstack/service-push`.
   The only inline path is host composition, not authorable configuration.
2. `push-delivery.zod.ts`, the route rule. Holds. `actionUrl` is admitted only when `PushRouteSchema.safeParse` succeeds and it is under 1024 bytes. `https://evil.example/x`, `//evil.example/x` and `/a/../../api/v1/me` are left out, and the delivery still goes. `notificationId` is present on both emit paths.
3. `push-delivery.zod.ts`, the origin paragraph. **Should-fix:** with the marker gone, "copied here by the push channel" reads as served, but the registry stores no origin yet, so today every push goes without one. The member is optional and `UserDeviceSchema.origin` still says PLANNED, so the contract is not falsified. One clause on the member would close it, and it can ride the #29767 follow-up.
4. `push-device.zod.ts`. The ownership paragraph holds. **Should-fix**, filed as a follow-up and not blocking: the `locale` description is a claim the tree does not have (③ out-of-scope 1).
5. `notification-service.ts` and `error-code-ledger.zod.ts`. Hold.
   - Retirement: `DeviceRegistry.invalidate(token)` keeps the row and writes `enabled: false` and `invalidated_at`.
   - The acceptance test covers it: the 410 device is retired, the other device still gets the push, and the retired device is not pushed again.
   - Retiring by token is right. A throwing `invalidateDeviceToken` is caught and does not change the grade.
6. `notification.zod.ts`. Holds.
7. ADR-0012 against its first consumer, its execution plan and ADR-0030. Holds.
   - The status line gets a dated `Amended (2026-11-03, #29041)` clause (ADR-0053's shape). It covers the unedited `plugin-notification-push` rows.
   - The §4 push row reads Shipped.
   - §6 moves retirement to the channel and gives the grade rule: `invalid_recipient` only when every device died. That matches `push-channel.ts` and `backoff.ts`.
   - ADR-0030 is unchanged and consistent.
8. Grading. When one device is sent and another fails retryably, the message is recorded delivered and not retried, so no device is pushed twice. A device on an unconfigured vendor grades `permanent`, not `invalid_recipient`. Right.

No must-fix. Two should-fix items (④ 3 and 4), both carried to follow-ups.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：通知现在能推送到手机。新增推送服务包 `@objectstack/service-push`（苹果 APNs、谷歌 FCM），消息服务新增“推送”渠道：流程里的通知节点选了推送，就发到收件人登记过的每一台手机，点开推送进入这条通知对应的页面；手机端应用已卸载（令牌失效）时，自动停用那台设备。同时修订 ADR-0012（通知平台）：推送包名定为 `service-push`，§4 推送一行改为“已上线”，§6 写明失效令牌由推送渠道停用；ADR-0030 未改。
- 为什么改：#29041 的验收条件。之前流程里选了推送也显示“运行成功”，实际一条推送都没有发出（已在 main 上复现）。
- 风险与回滚：纯新增。没有启用推送服务的部署，行为完全不变；推送密钥只能通过引用（`credentialRef`）配置，写明文密钥会在启动时被拒绝；推送里带的跳转只会是本服务器内的路径，外站链接一律不带。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/push-channel.ts`（发给哪些手机、失效设备停用、结果怎么分级），再看 `docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md` 的修订处。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/builtin/notify-push-delivery.integration.test.ts`，预期 3 条全过：模拟的苹果和谷歌推送服务各收到一条带跳转的推送，被报失效的设备变为停用，同一用户的另一台手机照常收到。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（`docs/adr/**`）：席位契约复核已通过（评论 6596752211，`Head-sha: 3aac0c5938b09d8b7a6cb7ffa88507dca5ec7cfb`），请 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 之一批准 ADR-0012 的这次修订；批准后席位落地。
- 席位意见：建议批准。包名按你的裁决 A 定为 `service-push`；ADR 修订只记录本 PR 落地的行为，不新作决定。还差两件事已另立卡：部署配置里还开不了推送（#29820），设备语言目前不参与推送文案（#29818）。

**HOLD** · `domain:server#4` · head `3aac0c5938b09d8b7a6cb7ffa88507dca5ec7cfb` · 2026-11-03T07:36Z · the hand-off in ACCEPT 6596988879 is withdrawn. This PR waits behind #29816, then gets a rework round.

The ADR-0012 edit is re-cut against #29817's order of landing. The seat then runs a delta contract review on the new head and posts a fresh ACCEPT with the hand-off.
4. **State:** `needs-user-decision` comes off with this record. The review request stays open on the platform, but no approval is asked for until the fresh ACCEPT.
